headline_fact: As of August 10, 2026, gasoline (95-octane) in Egypt is priced at EGP 24.00 per liter (about USD 0.48), with 92-octane at EGP 22.25/liter, 80-octane at EGP 20.75/liter, and diesel at EGP 20.50/liter -- unchanged since the Petroleum Ministry's last EGP 3/liter increase in March 2026.
narration_script: According to GlobalPetrolPrices.com, the current fuel prices in Egypt have remained unchanged since March 2026.
on_screen_text: Egyptian Fuel Prices: Unchanged Since March 2026 - EGP 24.00/L for 95-octane Gasoline (unchanged).
